Hi, I'm El Hadji. I'm a senior at Pitzer College (Class of 2027) majoring in
Organizational Studies with a concentration in Management and a minor in
Data Science. I'm originally from Dakar, Senegal.

I work as a product manager on the Pitzer Hub portal, and I'm interested
in how data and product thinking come together, especially in AI products.

## Education

**Pitzer College** | Claremont, CA  
B.A. Organizational Studies, Data Science minor | Expected May 2027

**African Institute of Management** | Dakar, Senegal  
BBA, Digital Marketing and Management | 2023
